clips.title: The story
paras: In Coldridge Valley, a message calls new gnome warriors to Anvilmar. Sten Stoutarm passes along Thran Khorman’s summons, inviting trained fighters to learn the arts of war and prepare to reclaim Gnomeregan.

As you help Sten Stoutarm drive off troggs and boars in Coldridge Valley, he receives a short message for a young gnome warrior. Thran Khorman, a veteran trainer in Anvilmar, sees promise in the refugee fighter. He calls the newcomer to the central hall to begin martial instruction.

Dwarven trainers may tease gnome warriors about their size, but Thran Khorman takes their loss seriously. He asks them to imagine how dwarves would feel if Ironforge fell to the Dark Irons. Thran has pledged to help the exiled gnomes, and he will teach them the arts of war until they are ready to reclaim their home.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: While you were helping me out, this memorandum was given to me to pass on to you. Take some time to read it when you have a chance. I'm thinkin' it came from the warrior trainer Thran. Take a gander at it and go find him inside Anvilmar when you've a chance.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Ah, well, another memorandum from a traveler on a mission... Isn't this quaint.

No, no, I ain't teasin' ya, little one. Gotta respect your tenacity, that much is fer sure. I'd be just as peeved if Ironforge was taken by Dark Iron dwarves, so don't be thinkin' I don't feel for your plight...

clips.title: Completion
paras: Well, seein' how this is your prime directive, or whatever yer callin' it these days, I gave my word I'd do whatever I can to make sure you and yours were ready to take back your home... And that's just what I'm gonna do.
Any time you feel yer ready, come back to good ol' Thran and I'll be happy to share my knowledge wit ya. There's some cost to me trainin' ya, but it won't be too expensive. Good luck.
